0.original: Maru hopes you will be amenable to acquiring anemones.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

25.original: Deliver the redbloom anemones to Maru.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, would you be willin' to go scrape me up some redbloom anemones? There's this recipe I wanna try...

49.original: You'll wanna look just off the coast of Saltwind's Welcome. If you could grab me a couple growin' close to the water's surface, I'd be much obliged.

51.original: These're them! Redblooms are universal─fishers use 'em for moochin', and they're delicious deep-fried or steamed in coconut milk. With fronds like these, who needs other anemones?

52.original: ...A-Anyway, since they're so popular, you're only allowed to harvest 'em from certain areas. Don't wanna get too greedy, after all...
